changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54: the LOOPER machine turns one audio track into a live looper that records the master mix or inputs all the time.
CAPT and ONCE catch the loop playing now with FILL (press PAGE) or UP; PICK keeps it playing through pattern changes with no trigs, and PTCH or WARP follow the tempo.
LEN sets the loop in steps, or PT.LEN follows the pattern's own length. Loops are cut to their exact length with a short fade at each end.
An arm made while stopped records from PLAY; STOP pressed while stopped calls it off. GLOB keeps the loop track's sends, filter, amp or all of it the same in every pattern.
Page 2 works as the stock second pages: hold SRC for the values, and turning a knob shows its name and value in the header.
Push D on its SRC page to keep a loop as a sample through the stock trim editor.
Based on sumedho's RAM Machines, with one machine of its own; it cannot be combined with RAM Machines or Digi Health.

Known issues: the loop is lost at power-off; changing PLAY mode mid-play restarts the loop; in PICK, PTCH and WARP the track's trig key restarts the loop (reported, not yet reproduced); an open Overbridge instance slows the unit.
